tools.name: add_code_connect_map
tools.intent: Map a Figma component to its code component in your codebase so later design-to-code output reuses the exact project component.

tools.name: create_generative_plugin
tools.intent: Create a starter generative plugin in your Figma library, which draws a square; requires the figma-generative-plugins skill and a planKey, then follow with update_generative_plugin.

tools.name: create_new_file
tools.intent: Create a blank Figma Design, FigJam or Slides file in your drafts, asking which team or organization when you belong to several.

tools.name: create_shader
tools.intent: Create a starter shader effect or fill in your Figma library; requires the figma-shaders skill and planKey, then use update_shader to add behavior.

tools.name: download_assets
tools.intent: Download up to 20 nodes per call as PNG, JPG, SVG or PDF exports plus original source images, returned as temporary URLs; use to deliver or move assets.

tools.name: generate_diagram
tools.intent: Generate a FigJam diagram (flowchart, Gantt, state, sequence, architecture, ERD) from a description or Mermaid syntax, into a new or existing FigJam file.

tools.name: generate_figma_design
tools.intent: Send the live UI of a running web app or site into Figma as design layers, in a new file, existing file or clipboard.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.intent: Generate a PNG or JPEG image from a text prompt using Figma AI credits; the link expires after 7 days, so add it to a file with upload_assets.

tools.name: get_code_connect_map
tools.intent: Return the Code Connect mappings for instances in the selection: component name, source path, snippet and framework label, for reusing existing code components.

tools.name: get_code_connect_suggestions
tools.intent: Detect Figma components and suggest which code components to map them to; a step inside the Code Connect workflow, not usually called directly.

tools.name: get_context_for_code_connect
tools.intent: Return component properties, variant options and nested instances used to generate Code Connect templates; a workflow step of the figma-code-connect skill.

tools.name: get_design_context
tools.intent: Main design-to-code tool: returns design context and generated code (React and Tailwind by default) for a Figma layer or selection.

tools.name: get_figjam
tools.intent: Return an XML outline of FigJam diagrams plus screenshots of the nodes; use for FigJam files, as get_metadata does not cover them.

tools.name: get_generative_plugin
tools.intent: Read a generative plugin from your Figma library by ID: name, owner, version and source file URIs; works only for plugins you own.

tools.name: get_libraries
tools.intent: List the libraries added to a Figma file and the libraries you could add, with name, key and description; use before search_design_system.

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.intent: Return a lightweight XML outline of a selection with layer IDs, names, types, positions and sizes; use on very large designs before get_design_context.

tools.name: get_motion_context
tools.intent: Return keyframe tracks, easing, CSS keyframes and Motion snippets for an animated node; call after get_design_context to add the motion.

tools.name: get_screenshot
tools.intent: Take a PNG screenshot of one selection so the agent can see the design; for exporting assets in other formats use download_assets instead.

tools.name: get_shader
tools.intent: Read a shader effect or fill from your Figma library by ID: name, type, version and source file URIs.

tools.name: get_variable_defs
tools.intent: List the variables and styles, such as colors, spacing and typography, used in a Figma selection with their values.

tools.name: list_file_shaders
tools.intent: List up to 100 shader effects and fills used in a given Figma file at the exact version it uses; needs only view access.

tools.name: list_generative_plugins
tools.intent: List generative plugins in your Figma account library, including Figma's own, with id, name, description and owner, paginated by cursor.

tools.name: list_shaders
tools.intent: List the shader effects and fills in your Figma account library with id, name, owner and type, paginated by cursor; replaces the deprecated list_shader_* tools.

tools.name: search_design_system
tools.intent: Search all connected libraries for components, variables and styles matching a text query, batching several searches, so existing assets are reused.

tools.name: send_code_connect_mappings
tools.intent: Confirm the Code Connect mappings proposed by get_code_connect_suggestions; a workflow step of the figma-code-connect skill.

tools.name: send_code_to_figma
tools.intent: Import a local project archive into Figma as a Figma Make file's code or a code layer in a Design file, not design layers; needs edit access.

tools.name: update_generative_plugin
tools.intent: Update a generative plugin's code.ts or ui.html with complete contents and a commit message; Figma builds and deploys it. Needs the figma-generative-plugins skill.

tools.name: update_shader
tools.intent: Update a shader's main.ts with complete file contents and a commit message; Figma builds and deploys it. Kind cannot change. Requires the figma-shaders skill.

tools.name: upload_assets
tools.intent: Upload PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP or SVG files (up to 60 per call, 10 MB each) into a Figma file as fills or editable vector layers.

tools.name: use_figma
tools.intent: General-purpose tool to create, edit, delete and inspect content in Figma Design, FigJam, Slides and Specs files via JavaScript; requires loading the figma-use skill first.

tools.name: weave_cancel_tool_run
tools.intent: Cancel one or more in-progress Figma Weave tool runs, or all runs of a tool when run IDs are omitted; cannot be undone.

tools.name: weave_find_model
tools.intent: Find a Figma Weave model by name, returning its approximate cost and accepted inputs, so it can be run directly with weave_run_model.

tools.name: weave_get_model_run_output
tools.intent: Get status and output with download links for Weave model runs started by weave_run_model; use weave_get_tool_run_output for published tools.

tools.name: weave_get_tool_inputs
tools.intent: Get the version, outputs summary and typed inputs a published Weave tool needs; call before weave_run_tool.

tools.name: weave_get_tool_run_output
tools.intent: Get status, progress, errors and output of runs of a published Weave tool by recipeId and optional run IDs.

tools.name: weave_list_tools
tools.intent: List the Weave tools you can run in your active Weave workspace, optionally filtered by name, with creator and link; private tools excluded.

tools.name: weave_run_model
tools.intent: Run a Weave model directly without a published tool; uses Weave credits, shows cost and needs approval for every run, including reruns.

tools.name: weave_run_tool
tools.intent: Run a published Weave tool with inputs, one to ten runs; returns run IDs, and asks for cost confirmation first because runs use Weave credits.

tools.name: weave_upload_asset
tools.intent: Upload an image, video, audio or 3D model file as input for weave_run_tool, returning a single-use submit URL and permanent hosted URL.

tools.name: whoami
tools.intent: Return your Figma email, plans and seat types; needed for the planKey required to create generative plugins and shaders.
